name: OpenFillAction
description: Dutch-auction swap: offers its whole input for a flat demandPerFill of the demanded token, and any filler can take it. It has no cap of its own: feed it from a stream with a maxBudget, which sets the worst price (demandPerFill over the most the node can receive). Restarts its budget when the manager changes demandPerFill (setDemandPerFill, which needs SET_SETTINGS_PERMISSION_ID): it requires CHECKPOINT_PERMISSION_ID on that budget, which the setup grants.

dependencies.name: budget
dependencies.description: The flow's stream budget, which the setup supplies; the action restarts it when the demand changes.

settings.name: demandedToken
settings.description: The token the DAO must receive: an ERC20 (use WETH for ether), not the budget's token. Native ETH isn't supported.

settings.name: demandPerFill
settings.description: How much of the demanded token must come back per fill. Non-zero.

initialization: Setup supplies [flowBudget] as deps; this action uses it.
